MESSAGES.REGISTER_START:
Hello user!

Before we start registration, I would like to know in which language you prefer to communicate with me.

Please note that this choice will affect our further communication. After registration, your profile will indicate that you speak this language.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_START_FAILURE: You have not selected a language for communication!
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_1:
Thank you! Now I can speak to you in a language that is convenient for you.

My name is CRM BOT, I help with our blood organization. To use me, you need to register an account. Nothing will happen to your data, and things like the password will be encrypted and will not be shared in any way. Let's start the registration process!

The first step. Send me your Telegram contact and we will speed up the registration process many times.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_1_FAILURE: This is not your contact! Please click the button below.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_2: The second step. Enter your date of birth in the format DD-MM-YYYY. In case of a mistake, you will have one more try.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_2_FAILURE: Date of birth entered incorrectly! It must be written in the format DD-MM-YYYY.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_3: The third step. Choose your gender.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_3_FAILURE: Wrong gender selected! Please select one of the above.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_4: The fourth step. Enter your mail in the format mail@mail.com
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_4_FAILURE: The mail was entered in the wrong format! Please write it as mail@mail.com.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_5:
The fifth step. Enter the password for your future account. The password will not be distributed anywhere and will be encrypted.

The password must consist of numbers, upper and lower case letters of the Latin alphabet. The use of special characters, except for the underscore, is prohibited.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_5_FAILURE: The password does not meet the requirements! Please create a password that meets the requirements above.
